kitDescription: Mast: Romantic Maid is a Water MG Supporter (Burst II) whose kit revolves around a self-applied 'Drunken' status: each time any ally enters Burst stage 1 she gains a stack (max 3), and each stack cuts her own Hit Rate by 20%, costing her MG spray accuracy. While she holds at least one stack, the whole team gets a continuous +20.05% Critical Rate and a flat ATK grant equal to 35.02% of her ATK. When any ally enters Burst stage 3 while she is Drunken, the team gains Distributed Damage and Reload Speed scaled by her current stack count for 10 seconds. Her burst gives all allies +40.04% Critical Damage and +15.04% Attack Damage for 10 seconds, plus — if she is Drunken — another flat ATK grant of 20.06% of her ATK per stack. The catch: when Drunken reaches 3 stacks at the end of a Full Burst, she wipes all stacks and stuns herself (Hangover) for 10 seconds, losing her own fire and the team aura until she re-stacks.

S2b 'stun window present as >=9s gap in shot log' — blind reader bug B: selfShots filters srcSlot, which shot events do not carry (returns []), compounded by A
S2b 'stacks CONSUMED: return to 1 after Hangover' — no live stack counter (C3)
S2b 'non-vacuity: reaches max stacks' — no live stack counter (C1/C3)

burst branch2 'per-stack flat casterAtk grant' — blind fixture defect A: 0 casts

skill1.driverSaid: No live stack counter; Hit Rate ▼ modeled as normalAttackPct -40 on self (the ~40% miss rate at the 2-stack cycle average), validated vs real sample 149M vs 140M modeled
skill1.blindSaid: S5/S6: live drunken resource +1 on stageEnter:1, hitRatePct -20×stacks feeding the hrCoreMult core-rate path; S6 ⚑ flags the core-rate magnitude as measurement-gated
skill1.formulaCheck: Hit Rate is not itself a damage bucket; it acts through accuracy/core geometry. MG is flat-0.95 core (no accuracy circle), so the hrCoreMult path the blind assumed does not obviously bind an MG; the driver's damage-side miss emulation is a documented ⚑ with a real-fight anchor (0.94 ratio). Residual: kit-status F4 — normalAttackPct is damage-only, so her burst-gauge feed is NOT reduced the way truly missed shots would be (documented over-credit).
skill1.explanation: Same kit line, different primitive, both recorded. Driver's choice is data-validated and owner-known; the gauge-side over-credit is flagged in kit-status. Not silent.

skill1.driverSaid: Permanent passive, gate dropped: 'slight overcount during the ~1 rotation after each Hangover before she re-stacks'
skill1.blindSaid: S5: gated, dark before first stack and during post-Hangover gap. S6 caveat 3 independently quantifies the identical over-credit (~one FB tail per 3 rotations) and notes the engine lacks a buff-removal primitive to express the dark window
skill1.formulaCheck: Unscoped critRatePct is the correct stat (no 'normal attacks' scoping in the prose); value 20.05 flat (no ×stacks in the text) matches both blind authors. Only the gate timing differs.
skill1.explanation: Routing, stat, scope, and flat magnitude all converged three ways; the divergence is solely the gate, which is documented in the override note and independently cost-quantified by the blind S6 author as small.

skill1.kitLine: while Drunken → allies ATK ▲35.02% of user ATK
skill1.blindSaid: S5: casterAtkPct flat-resolved ≈0.3502×staticAtk, gated. S6: identical stat/value, keyed live from first B1
skill1.formulaCheck: SSOT: '% of caster's ATK' = caster's static ATK added FLAT outside the recipient's (1+ATK%) — driver test pins the flat value ≈34,927, identical across targets. Correct bucket, correct resolution. Gate caveat as above.
skill1.explanation: Three-way convergence on casterAtkPct flat resolution; only the documented gate approximation differs.

skill2.driverSaid: stageEnter:3, allies, 10s, static 30.06 = 15.03×2 cycle average (stacks run 1,2,3 then wipe; mean 2; 'exact sole-B2', board mean 0.9996)

Trigger stageEnter:3 (any ally's B3 cast) is correct — Mast is B2 and never casts B3. 10s wall-clock correct. Only per-rotation shape vs cycle-average differs; cycle totals equal.

skill2.blindSaid: S5/S6: perResource live 15.04/30.08/45.12; both blind authors affirm reload speed is damage-bearing (shots-fired), not skippable utility
skill2.formulaCheck: Reload Speed ▲ is subtractive on reload time (SSOT §11/§2a) and raises shots fired — modeled, correctly not skipped. Same documented cycle-average caveat as the distributed line.
skill2.explanation: Modeled with correct routing; static ×2 documented and blind-confirmed as the time-average.

skill2.kitLine: max stacks at FB end → wipe + Hangover stun 10s
skill2.driverSaid: burstCast everyN:3 on HER OWN casts (Q5 RECALIBRATION, owner-ruled 'her own Drunken' + data: a never-bursting Mast was being stunned 5× for 0.84 cold under fullBurstEnd; bursting Mast validated). No counter to wipe — none exists.
skill2.blindSaid: S5/S6: literal prose — fullBurstEnd + max-stacks gate, stun + resource wipe. Both were blind to the owner ruling by design.
skill2.formulaCheck: Stun stops her MG fire ~600 frames (shots-fired sink) — driver test behaviorally pins exactly ONE ~10s gap after the 3rd of 5 casts, matching the prose's cycle (stacks hit 3 at FB-end 3; wipe; rotations 4-5 sit at 1-2, no second hangover in 5 casts). everyN:3 is cycle-equivalent over this fight AND fixes the pathological never-bursting-Mast behavior the literal reading produced. Engine semantics let her still cast while stunned, consistent with S2b.
skill2.explanation: Owner-ruled re-gate, documented in the override note and kit-status (F1, measured, keep). The blind re-derived the literal prose because they could not see the ruling — a RECON_ERROR-class divergence against an owner adjudication, not a driver defect.

burst.explanation: Stat routing and flat resolution converged three ways; the static ×2 is documented and independently confirmed by the blind S6 author as the correct time-average.

gotchas.summary: Drunken stack currency not modeled live: stack gain on stage-1 entry, ×stacks scaling, and the Hangover wipe are folded into static cycle-average (×2) magnitudes
gotchas.evidence: Kit: 'stacks up to 3 times continuously', '15.03% x number of Drunken stacks', 'Removes all stacks'. Driver: static 30.06/30.08/40.12. Blind S6: live resource pool with perResource scaling — but S6 flag 2/3 independently confirm ×2 is the exact time-average of the 1,2,3 sawtooth. Cycle-total damage identical; only within-cycle rotation-to-rotation shape differs.
gotchas.suggestedFix: Optional fidelity upgrade, not a correctness fix: adopt the S6 resource-pool shape (resources:[{drunken, max:3}], +1 on stageEnter:1, perResource scaling, wipe on the Hangover block) if the engine's perResource path is verified — S6 itself flags perResource-on-casterAtkPct as UNVERIFIED against the engine and warns perResource recomputes per frame rather than snapshotting at cast, which would mis-drop open windows on the reset rotation. Current static form is cycle-exact; any change needs the stack trajectory pinned from a recording first.

gotchas.summary: Hit Rate ▼20%/stack modeled as normalAttackPct -40 self (damage-side miss emulation) rather than a hit-rate/core-path debuff; gauge feed is not reduced (kit-status F4)
gotchas.evidence: Kit: 'Hit Rate ▼ 20%, stacks up to 3 times'. Driver: normalAttackPct -40, validated 149M real vs 140M modeled. Blind: hitRatePct -20×stacks feeding hrCoreMult — but the SSOT gives MG a flat 0.95 core with no accuracy circle, so the blind's assumed path is itself not obviously binding for an MG. Driver's primitive is the data-validated one; the known residual is gauge over-credit (damage-only stat), documented in kit-status F4.
gotchas.suggestedFix: Keep the validated damage-side model; if refined, the gauge side should scale by the same miss fraction (skillGauge/gaugePerShot haircut while Drunken) — needs measurement: count her real burst-gauge contribution Drunken vs sober, e.g. a solo gauge-fill read per burst-gauge.md §5c.

verdictRationale: No undocumented divergence exists: every blind-vs-driver delta is either (i) a defect in the blind artifacts themselves — the S5 fixture (controlComp pins crown into the B2 slot so mrm casts 0 times, the exact failure S2b pre-warned about in writing) and the S5 srcSlot shot-event reader bug — or (ii) a documented, owner-ruled, or data-validated driver approximation (static ×2 cycle-average stacks, permanent S1 aura, normalAttackPct -40 Hit-Rate model, burstCast-everyN:3 Hangover), each of which the two blind authors independently corroborate in substance: S6's own flags derive the ×2 time-average (flags 2/3) and the permanent-aura over-credit size (caveat 3), and the Hangover re-gate is an owner ruling the blinds were structurally unable to see. Routing converged three ways on every load-bearing structural claim — casterAtkPct flat resolution, distributed-own-hits scoping, stageEnter:3 (not her own cast) keying, reloadSpeed/stun as shots-fired mechanics, burstCast (not fullBurstEnter) burst triggering — and the driver's 20 pins are green with working counterfactuals (self-only collapse, ×1-stack, stun-removal each discriminate). The three burst lines are byte-identical between the independent blind override and the driver. Residual same-model risk the owner should spot-check: (a) all convergence on the ×2/permanent-aura approximations is cycle-total, not per-rotation — if a fine-grained recording ever shows within-cycle buff magnitudes stepping ×1→×3 (e.g. an ally's distributed proc popup growing across rotations), the static model needs the S6 resource-pool upgrade; (b) the normalAttackPct -40 miss model is anchored to one real sample at 0.94 and its gauge-side over-credit (F4) is unmeasured; (c) the Q5 Hangover owner ruling is the single load-bearing human adjudication — if the owner revisits it, the everyN:3 encoding and its pin must move together.
